**Probable function:** This is **phosphoribosylaminoimidazole-succinocarboxamide synthase (SAICAR synthetase; EC 6.3.2.6)**.

**Likely biological process:** It participates in **de novo purine biosynthesis**, specifically the pathway leading to inosine monophosphate (IMP). The enzyme uses ATP to join L-aspartate to the purine-pathway intermediate 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate, forming SAICAR.

**Evidence and confidence:** The 250-aa sequence is an exact, full-length match to reviewed UniProt entry B8DTV0, annotated as this enzyme. A matching SAICAR_synt Pfam domain and closely related bacterial homologs support the assignment. Thus, the function is high-confidence; no specific cofactor requirement was reported in the retrieved results.
